name: shared-alias-index
goal: A change of desktop source that the hub imports through its alias reaches the hub units and selects their tests; nothing else in the index moves

steps.title: Identify the regression, prior working behavior, root cause, and evidence.
steps.evidence: Review at 514ef72: fifteen $desktop imports in six hub files are indexed as an outside package, so the graph has no edge. A change of hostedArtifact omits the hub page and four hub tests; hostedResponse omits 24 units and 12 tests; nothing broadens. work/hub-record-reader-draft/review-597351f/alias-impact-review.md

steps.title: Write and run a failing regression test that faithfully reproduces the defect; record proof.
steps.evidence: Unchanged tree 514ef72, test sha 6bff5bec, real index, graph and impact services with only entry hashes simulated: 5 failed. Fifteen imports unresolved, fifteen dependencies absent, fifteen omissions with the review's counts, hostedArtifact misses the hub page, three references declared for eighteen written. work/shared-alias-index/red/alias-red.log

steps.title: Propose a root-cause repair and an automated guard for the identified failure.
steps.evidence: Declare each of the fifteen imports as an exact reference with its owned target file, as the three earlier ones are, and re-index. Guard: test/shared-alias-index.test.ts on the real index, graph and impact analysis. No resolver change, alias rule, external entry or hand-written dependency

steps.title: Implement the repair and wire the prevention test or guard into normal project verification.
steps.evidence: harness.units.json gains fifteen references, each checked against the import as written and the target file; no earlier line changed. Re-indexing updated six hub manifests by fifteen derived dependencies. No source, runtime, description or scenario changed. The test runs in the root unit suite

steps.title: Repeat repair and the same unchanged regression test until it passes; record passing proof.
steps.evidence: Same test, sha 6bff5bec: 5 passed; the earlier registry test, sha b3c336cd: 4 passed (work/shared-alias-index/green). Public impact command in a scratch repository, one changed line in hostedArtifact: 116 tests selected with the five hub units and four hub tests, 112 and none with the mapping reverted (work/shared-alias-index/cli). 41 uncertainties both ways

steps.title: In an isolated fixture or temporary workspace, prove reintroducing the original failure makes the guard fail; restore and prove it passes.
steps.evidence: Scratch copy, unmutated 9 passed. Fifteen declarations reverted: 5 failed. Target another owned file: 5 failed. Target no file: 5 failed. Declared external: 4 failed. One type import undeclared: 3 failed. units check called each stale (work/shared-alias-index/mutants). Controls: only the alias's own outside count moved, 18 to 0 (work/shared-alias-index/controls)

steps.title: Repeat until the guard and relevant project checks pass; verify affected UI flows with fresh inspected screenshots and keep pending while proof fails.
Reproduce on the fifteen-map tree that a change of the shared Select misses its eight consumers.
steps.evidence: Fifteen-map tree, config sha 61bde14d, test sha 52b6c8cf, real index, graph and impact services with only the Select hash simulated: 5 failed. Eight imports unresolved and eight dependencies absent; a Select change misses its consumers, two hub pages, two desktop tests and two scenarios. work/shared-alias-index/shared-select/red/select-red.log

steps.title: Declare the eight exact Select imports and re-index the derived manifests.
steps.evidence: harness.units.json gains eight references, one for each $shared/Select.svelte import, to packages/reports/src/components/Select.svelte; no earlier line changed. Re-indexing gave each of the eight consumer manifests one derived dependency on reports.component.select. No source, runtime, scenario or description changed; the six earlier manifests keep their hashes

steps.title: Run the same unchanged Select regression and the nine earlier tests until they pass.
steps.evidence: Same test, sha 52b6c8cf: 5 passed; the nine earlier tests pass unchanged (work/shared-alias-index/shared-select/green). Public impact command in a scratch repository, one changed line in Select: 8 of 8 consumers, 6 pages, 141 tests and 14 scenarios; with the eight reverted 3 consumers, 4 pages, 139 tests and 12 scenarios (work/shared-alias-index/shared-select/cli). 41 uncertainties both ways

steps.title: Prove in a scratch copy that reverting the eight declarations or a wrong target fails the regression.
steps.evidence: Scratch copy, unmutated 14 passed. Eight declarations reverted: 5 failed. Target another owned file: 5 failed. Target no file: 5 failed. Declared external: 3 failed. One hub import undeclared: 5 failed. units check called each stale (work/shared-alias-index/shared-select/mutants). Audit: no import through a declared build alias is held as outside (work/shared-alias-index/shared-select/controls)
